cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: See What This Took
cards.instruction: Make someone recognize the courage, restraint, or emotional labor your choices required.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I told the committee I couldn't chair another year. Please appreciate what those two sentences took.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Good. Could you stay on until we find someone?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I rehearsed in your car until I stopped apologising. That wasn't me advertising a temporary vacancy.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then I'll tell them you're exhausted and need a break.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please don't supply the excuse I spent an hour removing. Could you recognise a refusal I finally managed without one?

mechanism: A corrects how B evaluates a choice so B recognizes the restraint or courage it took.
confusable: Seeking approval of the result differs from demanding recognition of the invisible effort required to choose it.
comparison: An edited apology hides angry material; a committee resignation embodies practiced refusal.
seedUse: Keep the letter restraint and refusal practice distinct; correction must reveal effort without neutral coaching commentary.
